data.name: Final Breach
data.detailed_description:
• Final Breach is a fast-paced wave-based FPS where stylized horror collides with high-impact gunplay. Step into a world on the brink of collapse, where twisted experiments, failed evacuations, and overrun districts have left only pockets of survivors struggling to hold back the tide. Every corner of the battlefield tells a story of desperation — ruined city blocks swallowed by infection, torn-apart facilities humming with malfunctioning power grids, abandoned neighborhoods littered with barricades and the remnants of last stands.

  • Made by a single developer, Final Breach is an intense zombie first person shooter where your only goal is to survive as long as you can and aim to reach the highest wave on the leaderboards. Upgrade your weapons, from a pistol all the way to ray zappers with different attachments and different sights. Round 1 might start off easy, but the higher the round gets the more zombies there are and with increased health and damage.

  • As the waves begin, the undead surge forward with increasing ferocity. Each round pushes you harder, demanding sharper aim, faster reflexes, and smarter resource management. Earn points by surviving, eliminate threats with precision, and use your momentum to unlock new weapons as the pressure intensifies. From reliable sidearms to devastating power weapons, every gun feels distinct, impactful, and built for carnage.

  • Uncover special weapons hidden across the environment, experiment with different loadouts, and refine your strategy with each attempt. No two runs unfold the same — sometimes you’ll dominate early and crumble late, other times you’ll barely survive the opening waves only to snowball into a powerhouse run. Every attempt is another chance to push deeper, learn enemy patterns, optimize your path, and fight longer against impossible odds.

  • Between the chaos, perk machines offer powerful boosts that reshape your playstyle. Whether you want heightened speed, hardened defense, boosted recovery, or enhanced lethality, each upgrade helps you claw your way through the next onslaught. Managing ammo, scavenging opportunities between waves, and rebuilding what little defense remains becomes essential as enemies evolve and aggression spikes.

The outbreak is spreading. The cities are failing. And the breach is widening with every passing moment.

Face the horde. Hold the line. And see just how long you can survive the Final Breach.

data.short_description: Final Breach is a stylized PBR horde survival FPS. Battle endless waves of grotesque undead in vibrant, high-fidelity maps. Upgrade your arsenal, grab powerful perks, and wield devastating firepower as the chaos intensifies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225 3.3 GHz or equivalent
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7300U 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7870 equivalent DX11 GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains cartoon blood, cartoon guns and weapons, cartoon zombies, violence between player killing zombies with guns, knives and grenades.
